historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Adds verified host identity, complete non-truncated outputs, package/boot provenance and field-level comparison.

historical_reviews.v3_1: Read-only collection is automatable only when the expected OS/kernel specification is supplied; review completion is not a DUT verdict.

original_test_intent: Verify the approved Linux distribution/release and running kernel version reported by the SUT match the system specification.
original_method: Collect complete os-release, uname and relevant boot/package provenance from the verified host through secure read-only access, then compare explicit fields.
manual_activity: User supplies the authoritative OS/kernel baseline and reviews the generated field comparison; no physical or GUI action is required.
required_inputs: Approved host identity and secure read-only access
Protected evidence location and comparison policy
safety_requirements: Verify host identity and managed authentication before collection
Preserve complete raw outputs and status
Stop on wrong host, permission failure, contradictory release/kernel evidence or instability
Do not update packages, alter boot state or reboot
agent_execution_scope: Collect complete os-release, uname, architecture and kernel command line
Produce explicit expected-versus-observed fields with raw checksums
Do not mutate packages/boot, infer absent expectations or issue DUT verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: cat /etc/os-release plus uname fits the read-only goal, but secure host verification, complete output and an expected baseline are required.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use managed secure access to collect full os-release, uname -a/-r/-m, kernel command line and package provenance with exit status and checksums.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: OS boot, uname intent, version Criteria and source 5/5 timing fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Generate a deterministic field-by-field distribution/kernel/architecture comparison backed by complete immutable raw evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds distro identity and provenance without changing the read-only version objective.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Expands evidence completeness but does not extend into hardware inventory or software support certification.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Reported version strings do not by themselves prove vendor support or image integrity unless a baseline/provenance is supplied.

project_override_considerations: The project must provide exact expected fields and acceptable build/kernel variations; the agent must not decide that any newer or similar version is acceptable.
expected_evidence: Architecture, kernel command line and package/kernel provenance
Tool exit status and raw-output checksums

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently define read-only OS version verification; adding os-release clarifies distribution identity without changing intent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Expected baseline and secure access are supplyable inputs; static review is complete.

review_improvement: Turns a single ambiguous uname display into a complete secure, reproducible distribution/kernel comparison without state changes.
independent_technical_reasoning: uname primarily identifies the running kernel, while distribution release identity resides in os-release and may diverge after partial updates. Both must be captured with architecture and boot/package provenance; otherwise a correct-looking kernel string cannot prove the installed OS matches the approved image.
